logLossWinsAtLeast3Of4.rule: candidate log loss is lower in at least 3 of 4 folds

meanBrierNotWorse.rule: candidate mean Brier <= baseline mean Brier

meanLogLossImproved.rule: candidate mean temporal-fold LOG LOSS < baseline mean temporal-fold LOG LOSS

meanRocAucNotWorseByMoreThan0_01.rule: candidate mean ROC-AUC >= baseline mean ROC-AUC - 0.01

noFoldLogLossDegradationGreaterThan0_05.rule: no candidate fold log loss is more than 0.05 worse than corresponding baseline fold
